title: AFOSI founding director a devout Catholic; AFOSI behind early Collins Elite

tellings.quote: the founding director of Air Force Office of Special Investigations was a devout Catholic who wanted to go to seminary and suddenly found himself in intelligence.

plain: The first director of the Air Force Office of Special Investigations, the Air Force's own investigative branch, is said to have been a devout Catholic who "wanted to go to seminary and suddenly found himself in intelligence". A researcher named Jason Simosa tells Michels this without naming a source. He also links the office to the early days of a secretive group known as the Collins Elite, around 1948, which would mean religious belief shaped how the government handled the UFO question from the start.
